trash.header.subtitle: Sync recommended custom formats, quality profiles, naming schemes, and quality sizes from {link}.
trash.section.qualityProfiles.title: Quality Profiles
trash.section.qualityProfiles.descriptio: TRaSH quality profile templates. Applying a profile also applies any custom formats it references.
trash.section.customFormatGroups.title: Custom Format Groups
trash.section.customFormatGroups.descrip: TRaSH-curated bundles (HDR Formats, Release Groups HQ, Streaming Services, etc.). Applying a group applies every member custom format in one shot.
trash.section.customFormats.title: Custom Formats
trash.section.customFormats.description: CFs that will be POSTed/PUT to Radarr/Sonarr. Unmanage to stop overwriting upstream changes.
trash.section.naming.title: Naming
trash.section.naming.description: Naming schemes. Applying merges selected templates into Radarr/Sonarr's media-management config.
trash.section.qualitySizes.title: Quality Sizes
trash.section.qualitySizes.description: TRaSH's recommended min/preferred/max size per quality. Applying overlays these onto Radarr/Sonarr's quality definitions — untouched qualities keep their current values.
trash.banner.truncatedBody: The TRaSH-Guides repo exceeded GitHub's recursive-tree response cap on the last refresh ({at}). Some specs may have been silently skipped.
trash.banner.truncatedHint: Configure a GitHub personal access token on the Settings tab to lift rate limits, then click Refresh Catalog. If the issue persists, the upstream repo has outgrown the API page size — file an issue.
trash.notConfigured: {service} is not configured. Set the URL and API key in {settings} before applying specs.
trash.token.title: GitHub Token
trash.token.description: GitHub limits unauthenticated API calls to 60/hour — enough for a few refreshes. Paste any {link} (no scopes needed, public-repo read is the default) to raise it to 5 000/hour. Stored encrypted at rest when {envVar} is set.
trash.sync.title: Sync Settings
trash.sync.subtitle: Enable the master toggle, then pick which kinds of specs the cron job re-applies each run.
trash.sync.refreshAlreadyRunning: Refresh already running — try again shortly
trash.sync.toggle.enabled.label: TRaSH Sync Enabled
trash.sync.toggle.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the trash-sync cron job exits immediately.
trash.sync.toggle.customFormats.label: Sync Custom Formats
trash.sync.toggle.customFormats.descript: Re-apply managed CFs on every sync. Overwrites manual edits in Radarr/Sonarr.
trash.sync.toggle.customFormatGroups.des: Re-apply managed TRaSH CF-Groups (HDR Formats, Release Groups HQ, etc.). Each group cascades to its member CFs.
trash.sync.toggle.qualityProfiles.label: Sync Quality Profiles
trash.sync.toggle.naming.label: Sync Naming
trash.sync.toggle.qualitySizes.label: Sync Quality Sizes
trash.sync.toggle.qualitySizes.descripti: Re-apply managed quality-size templates (Radarr/Sonarr quality definition sliders).
trash.starter.title: Profile Library
trash.starter.description: Every TRaSH quality profile, naming scheme, and quality-size template in the catalog. The {recommended} baseline for 1080p movies and TV is pre-selected; applying any quality profile cascades to every custom format it references.
trash.starter.refreshTitle: Pull the latest catalog from TRaSH
trash.starter.catalogEmptyHint: Click Refresh Catalog above to pull the TRaSH catalog into the database. This takes ~20 s the first time; subsequent refreshes only fetch changed specs.
trash.starter.missingCount: {count} missing — try Refresh Catalog, then check upstream naming
trash.starter.someFailed: One or more failed — see below
trash.spec.emptyCatalog: No specs pulled yet — click Refresh Catalog on the Settings tab.
trash.spec.noMatch: No specs match the current filter.
trash.spec.col.name: Name
trash.spec.someFailedLog: One or more failed — see log below
TRaSH's default for 1080p Blu-ray + WEB-DL movies. Pulls in the HQ release-group CFs, blocks low-quality sources, and sets sane scoring.
trash.starter.pack.radarrNaming.label: Movies: TRaSH standard naming
trash.starter.pack.radarrNaming.rational: TRaSH's canonical file + folder naming pattern for movies (standard format, Plex/Emby/Jellyfin variants kept as options).
TRaSH's default for 1080p WEB-DL TV. Works for everything streaming services release; add Bluray profile later if needed.
trash.starter.pack.sonarrNaming.label: TV: TRaSH standard naming
trash.starter.pack.sonarrNaming.rational: TRaSH's canonical episode + series + season folder naming pattern.
trash.starter.derived.rationale.qualityP: TRaSH quality profile. Applying it cascades to every referenced custom format.
trash.starter.derived.rationale.naming: TRaSH naming pattern — merged into Radarr/Sonarr's media-management config on apply.
trash.starter.derived.rationale.qualityS: TRaSH per-quality min/preferred/max MB-per-minute template — overlaid on the live quality definitions.
trash.starter.defaultInstanceNote: Applies to the default Radarr/Sonarr instance. For a named instance, use the Instance picker on the Custom Formats, Quality Profiles or Naming & Sizes tab.
